note: Five loops (Heron, Egret, Crane, Osprey, Seagull) of open and wooded sites, two areas of them tent-only, on the inland side of the park beside the Four Mile River marsh; the park's beach on Long Island Sound lies to the south. Cabins rent by the week, Sunday to Sunday. No pets. --Claude
